title: Stage 4 Mixture-of-Experts Adversarial Assessment: Modular Architecture Refactoring, Zero-Drift Core & Core UX Features

findings.title: Per-channel rule map & persona key normalization needed prototype-key exclusion and isolated non-executive cache partitioning
findings.resolution: normalizeChannelRuleKey(), normalizeChannelTitleRules(), and normalizeSummaryPersona() reject __proto__/constructor/prototype keys and unknown preset strings; writeCache()/readCache() isolate non-executive personas under sum:<persona>:<videoId> while preserving backward-compatible sum:<videoId> for executive.

findings.title: FEAT-02: Reverting a channel with data-dearrow-title from force_ai after global auto-title toggle off fell back to clickbait originalTitle instead of DeArrow title
findings.resolution: Updated syncDeArrowState() and revertCardToNonAiTitle() in youtube-feed-summariser.user.js to inspect and preserve card/title data-dearrow-title attributes cleanly, ensuring global kill switch restores DeArrow crowd titles immediately (verified in Check 45).

findings.title: Timestamp seek handler called nonexistent this.showTtsToast() on SummaryWindow and needed strict regex/XSS-free DOM construction
findings.resolution: Fixed SummaryWindow.seekPlayer() to invoke this.showTtsFeedback() and announceLive(), and verified zero Trusted-Types-unsafe innerHTML/outerHTML sinks in Test #28 alongside offline SVG data-URI asset generation in SimulatorTypes.ts.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 4 eliminates monolith drift risk and validates Trusted-Types safety + persona/channel rule isolation; Stage 5 offline archive bundle & chapter chunking is cleanly unblocked.

findings.title: AUD-08: Monolithic 4,422-line src/App.tsx risked logic drift against youtube-feed-summariser.user.js and had follow-up shorthand bug
findings.resolution: Decomposed src/App.tsx into focused modules under src/components/* (SimulatorTypes, TimestampText, ResponseRatingBar, TtsWaveformVisualizer, FeedSimulatorGrid, TtsControlBar, ReadabilityModal, FloatingSummaryWindow, HistoryDock, SettingsDocsTabs), fixed { q, a: answer } property binding in handleSendFollowUp, exported AdaptiveWindowFlags & persona export metadata, and added Test #34 running youtube-feed-summariser.user.js inside node:vm to assert exact functional parity against src/utils/userscript-helpers.ts.

findings.title: Userscript background polling intervals kept node:vm event loop open during Test #34 parity execution
findings.resolution: Wrapped setTimeout/setInterval handles in src/utils/userscript-helpers.test.ts VM sandbox with .unref() so all 34 unit & zero-drift parity tests complete cleanly in ~343ms.

roadmapReview.notes: 34/34 unit & zero-drift parity tests, Vite build, tsc --noEmit, and 476/476 Playwright E2E checks across all 5 suites verify high structural reliability entering Stage 5.

roleReviews.roleTitle: UX, Visual Layout & Spec Compliance Critic

findings.title: Round 1 live Chromium visual audit revealed 375px mobile bottom dock left-edge clipping ('istory (1)'), scrolled-away seek banner, and narrow System Prompt header word wrapping
findings.resolution: Updated HistoryDock.tsx to use justify-start sm:justify-end with flex-1 responsive docked tabs (histLeft=8, zero clipping), anchored [data-seek-banner] visibly below .yt-win-toolbar above .yt-win-body, placed Regenerate cleanly before TtsControlBar, and wrapped the systemInstruction badge row cleanly; verified in Round 2 live Chromium captures at 1440x900 and 375x812 (scrollWidth=375, 0 console errors/warnings).

findings.title: FEAT-01/02/03 accessibility & discoverability across Summary, Transcript Follow-Along Lock, Readability, and Feed cards
findings.resolution: Added aria-pressed Follow-Along Lock (.yt-follow-along-btn), ARIA live jump announcements ('Jumped to MM:SS'), keyboard-accessible per-channel rule menu (role=menu / menuitemradio) beside .yt-alt-title-btn, and live persona prompt preview updates.

roadmapReview.notes: All Stage 4 UX deliverables (AUD-08, FEAT-01, FEAT-02, FEAT-03) are verified visually and behaviorally across Userscript and Simulator; ready to advance to Stage 5 (stage-5-offline-export-bundle).
